Professional fashion photograph, vertical portrait-orientation close-up beauty portrait of FOUR women arranged in a diamond. All four face the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, heads level, both ears of every woman clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of #1's head down to the line of #4's shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them. Every face is large and sharp. All piercings: Each woman wears only the piercings named in her own paragraph, in those places and nowhere else; on every woman the eyes, eyelids and eyebrows stay completely clear. All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. The background colours are cool, mid-to-dark tones clearly different from their skin tones, never beige, peach, orange or brown, and never bright. One single light setup lights everyone from the same direction with the same colour, so the shadows and highlights match on every woman. A soft frontal light on all the faces and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 3:4 vertical 8K.
